name: SnapOtter
tagline: Self-hosted file toolkit for images, video, audio, PDFs, and files
description:
SnapOtter is an open-source, self-hosted file manipulation suite with 200+ tools across images, video, audio, PDFs, and files. It includes batch processing, reusable pipelines, local AI tools, a browser image editor, and a REST API so files stay on your own server.

This package uses SnapOtter's single-container embedded mode for an easy CasaOS install. PostgreSQL 17 and Redis 8 run inside the container when DATABASE_URL and REDIS_URL are left unset, with persistent data stored under /data.

Default login is admin / admin. SnapOtter asks you to change the default password after first login.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Default password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  snapotter:
    image: snapotter/snapotter:2.2.0
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: "1024M"
    network_mode: bridge
    ports:
      - target: 1349
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data
        target: /data
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/workspace
        target: /tmp/workspace
    environment:
      - AUTH_ENABLED=true
      - DEFAULT_USERNAME=admin
      - DEFAULT_PASSWORD=${SECRET_DEFAULT_PASSWORD}
      - MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB=0
      - MAX_BATCH_SIZE=0
      - CONCURRENT_JOBS=0
      - REDIS_MAXMEMORY=512mb
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-fsS", "http://localhost:1349/api/v1/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 90s
    container_name: snapotter
